title: A whole picture and a fair conclusion

captions.energy: Connecting different sides of the whole
captions.emotions: Feeling proportion within a shared assessment

meaning: Established knowledge can help you see the whole picture and reach a conclusion proportionate to your particular experience.
text: An understandable picture becomes more dependable when its conclusion has an accurate scale. The Hierophant in the physical position of Ajna suggests comparing experience with established principles. The World in energy supports connecting different aspects of the whole. Justice in emotions responds with proportion within a shared assessment.

For example, you read a guide to a small garden while discussing a few plants on a balcony. Particular recommendations seem clear, but considering the whole connects space, available time and your interests. **A whole view gives each principle an appropriate scale.** You can see which questions genuinely belong to your task. The source remains useful without requiring the entire intention described there to be reproduced. Fairness is felt through connection with actual conditions. Different expectations become easier to discuss because both people understand why some knowledge matters now while other knowledge belongs to another question.

The risk is treating an assembled picture as grounds for assessing every new possibility in advance. A detail has barely been examined before it receives a place within the structure. Seeking the whole can reveal its relationship to other material. A proportionate assessment may change while earlier examination retains value. Your shared view stays substantial when new material can genuinely contribute beyond confirming what is already understood.
